title: Item:Heroic True Heart of Blood
wikitext:
[[File:Heroic True Heart of Blood.png|thumb|right|420px|Heart of Blood]] 

'''Heroic True Heart of Blood''' is used for [[Racial Reincarnation]]: to reset your character's abilities, [[skills]], change their appearance and [[race]] or [[class]] while also gaining [[Past Life Feat|past life]] bonuses, feats and more [[Abilities|ability]] points.

Your character must be [[Level]] 20 or higher to use this item.

A Heroic True Heart of Blood can be acquired in several ways:
* Purchase it in the [[DDO Store]]. These are {{Bind|BtA|BoA}}.
* Trade {{Tot12|20}} (formerly known as Epic Dungeon Tokens) with [[Lahar]], the Epic vendor, outside the [[Tower of the Twelve]]. These are {{Bind|BtC|BoA}}.


'''Caution:''' When purchasing or using a Heart for Reincarnation, be careful to select the one you want - a '''Heart of ''Blood''''' vs. a '''Heart of ''Wood'''''.
